dogecoin.text:
$DOGE dropped by 70% from its ATH and found support at €0.2, which is the lowest since April.

After a strong rebound in the last 24 hours, it’s now trading at €0.3.

Despite the drop, $DOGE is still one of the best performing assets year-to-date among all cryptocurrencies. https://t.co/xmgMudW69F

The cryptocurrency market is recovering from last month’s volatile correction and the bullish sentiment is slowly returning. 

The rally in #Dogecoin  has taken the centre stage as the meme coin picked up about 50% in last 3 days. https://t.co/jeJhjxW7Xd

The price of @Dogecoin surged some 35% following news that Twitter has accepted Elon Musk’s buyout deal. The meme coin is trading at around €0.15, up some 50% since its March low. https://t.co/qU1lMD0VBq

#Dogecoin surges on the back of Elon Musk’s takeover of Twitter, #Bitcoin trades sideways with some bullish signs and the broader market follows suit.
Read about this and more in our brand-new Bitpanda Pro weekly market recap: https://t.co/z9RKJXBe1F
